description: Records the user's consent to Forkmate storing and processing their health-related data, as summarised in the consent text that a refused log reply shows. Valid only as the user's own explicit agreement given in this conversation; an assistant agreeing on the user's behalf is not consent. Stores the consent version, the time, the connected app and the user's words, then logs any meal that was waiting for consent. Withdrawal is in Forkmate Settings.

user_statement.description: The user's own words agreeing, as they replied, e.g. 'yes, I agree'.

version.description: The consent version shown to the user.

name: give_consent

logged.description: Meals held until consent, now logged.

items.description: One diary entry: a meal with its foods.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the food was eaten.

id.description: Identifies the entry for a later edit or deletion.

macros.description: Calories and macros. Estimates, not lab-measured; not for insulin dosing.

unknown_macros.description: Macros missing from the source data: shown as 0 but unknown, not a real zero.

meal.description: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack, when set.
